name: Databank panel: open
action: Opens the databank drawer (sets the top pane to 60% and adds .active on #sq-splitter-main). IDEMPOTENT BY LOCATOR: the :not(.active) prefix matches only while the drawer is CLOSED, so calling it on an already-open panel resolves to nothing instead of toggling it shut. The drawer is COLLAPSED by default and its whole content (tab strip, + New databank, toolbar) is laid out with zero size until it is opened — squi's synthetic clicks reach those elements anyway, but a real user and any actionability-checking driver (Playwright) need this first.

name: Databank panel: close
action: Collapses the databank drawer back to the header bar. Mirror of dbk.panel.open: the .active prefix matches only while the drawer is OPEN, so it never re-opens a closed panel.

name: Databank panel: toggle
action: Unconditional toggle of the databank drawer. Prefer dbk.panel.open / dbk.panel.close — they are state-safe; this one flips whatever state the user left the panel in.

name: Databank panel: maximize
action: Maximizes the drawer over the dashboard (adds .maximised). Rendered only while the drawer is OPEN, so run dbk.panel.open first.

name: Databank panel: restore
action: Un-maximizes the drawer (removes .maximised). Rendered only while the drawer is MAXIMISED.
